# KI: Cryptographic Merkle Tree Chaining & HDF5 Claim Drift Audit Engine

## Operational Summary
Forensic and safety-critical agent execution requires non-repudiable audit logs. Linking every event into an immutable SHA-256 hash chain starting from a known genesis hash guarantees immediate detection of tampering or corrupted execution records, while HDF5 claim matrix comparisons detect epistemic drift between retrieved knowledge and canonical ground truth.
